item.title: Breaking: Macquarie faces $14m fine for savings rate failures
item.description: Macquarie Bank has admitted to failures in the promotion of its "welcome" interest rate for new savings account customers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephanie Chalmers and Nassim Khadem

item.title: Coral colony the size of three MCGs thriving off remote Australian island
item.description: An enormous rose coral colony, one of the largest ever recorded, is mapped by a team of researchers off the Cocos (Keeling) Islands. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Amy Rossbach

item.title: Gold Coast AFLW player delisted just weeks out from giving birth
item.description: The AFLW's pregnancy policy is called into question with a Suns player delisted just weeks out from giving birth. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Marnie Vinall

item.title: Legends urge Australia to 'move on' from Sandpapergate amid opposing claims
item.description: As Mitchell Starc and Usman Khawaja's recollections of the 2018 incident differ, Adam Gilchrist says Australia must move on. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Why does Australia want Brits to swap Sydney for the outback?
item.description: Australia wants changes to UK deal that would push backpackers out of Bondi and into remote regions. Fuente: BBC News - World.

item.title: US charges three men over terror plots, including planned assault on UK airbase
item.description: Three men are charged by US authorities with plotting a "campaign of terror" of nearly 20 attacks targeting Jewish communities in Europe and the US and the British military base at RAF Fairford. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Review finds Bendigo hospital did not follow procedure for brain deaths
item.description: A review of deaths at Bendigo Health's intensive care unit finds a patient's relative felt "hurried" and "pressured" to decide about organ donation, with four cases raising significant concerns. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nicole Ferrie

item.title: Missing father in dispute with criminal rivals before disappearing, police say
item.description: NSW Police said when the family called his mobile phone on the night of his disappearance, they believed they could hear a man screaming before the call ended. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Sinner targeting Australian Open return after earlier 'impossible goal'
item.description: The two-time champion at Melbourne Park has no plans to miss out next year after having his 2026 season cruelled by injury. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Damning report urges new investigations into Epstein associates
item.description: US politicians are calling for further investigations into Jeffrey Epstein's associates in a scathing report blaming prosecutors, financial institutions and powerful connections for allowing his abuse to continue. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Lifesavers to trial AI tool to detect rip currents
item.description: UNSW researchers say the tool can pick out a rip in a photograph of a beach, and hope it can be used to help save lives. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Declan Bowring

item.title: Live: Wall Street retreats as hot inflation shortens odds of a rate hike, ASX set to slide
item.description: Wall Street hit the brakes as higher-than-expected inflation looks to have cemented a December rate hike, while the ASX is priced to slide as well. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Letts

item.title: South Road scandal to become subject of parliamentary inquiry
item.description: The Malinauskas government's handling of alleged bikie infiltration into the $15.4 billion Torrens to Darlington project is set to face more scrutiny. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Thomas Kelsall

item.title: Live: Transport minister says Qantas job cut decision 'extremely disappointing'
item.description: Catherine King says Labor would have considered taking a stake in the national carrier if it were in government during the COVID pandemic. Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Boscaini

item.title: 100yo soldier corrects service records, receives medals 80 years later
item.description: Ian Hart wore replica medals for decades after serving in the Australian Army. He has now been awarded the official service medals he earned. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emily Dobson

item.title: Experts urge people not to drink unpasteurised milk as products pushed online
item.description: A recent national survey by the Food Safety Information Council found about one-in-six Australians are consuming potentially dangerous raw milk products. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Ned Hammond

item.title: Victorian polling centre closures a 'kick in the teeth', say voters
item.description: Residents in central Victoria say the closure of three local polling booths is a "kick in the teeth" for rural communities, with some facing longer trips to vote in the upcoming state election. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nate Woodall and Fiona Parker

item.title: IVF patient fears Catholic takeover will affect quest to become a mum
item.description: Moments before going into surgery, Hayley Deniss was told about a potential disruption to her IVF care. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Ben Clifford

item.title: Motorcyclist and car driver killed in crash in Melbourne's south-east
item.description: A motorcycle rider and a car driver died at the scene after their vehicles collided, with police investigating the circumstances. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Workers at notorious youth justice centre compensated $7m for violence
item.description: Workers reported occupational violence every 2.6 days in the three years before Malmsbury Youth Justice Centre closed in 2023. It has since reopened as the Victorian government pledges a youth crime crackdown. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Anna McGuinness

item.title: Why are these purple flowers shutting down streets in Sydney?
item.description: Jacaranda trees typically flower for six weeks every spring, drawing visitors to Australia from across the globe. Fuente: BBC News - World.
